problems.title: Jump Game
problems.gist: A row of n stepping stones is numbered 0 to n - 1, and you start on stone 0. Stone i carries the number nums[i]: from it you may jump forward by any distance from 1 up to nums[i] (a 0 means you cannot jump from that stone).

problems.title: Jump Game II
problems.gist: A courier robot moves along a row of n charging pads numbered 0..n-1 and starts on pad 0. Pad i holds nums[i], the longest forward hop allowed from it: from pad i the robot may move to any pad i + j with 0 <= j <= nums[i] and i + j < n.

problems.title: Gas Station
problems.gist: There are n charging pads on a circular route, numbered 0 to n - 1. Pad i gives gas[i] units of charge, and flying from pad i to pad (i + 1) mod n uses cost[i] units. The battery has no upper limit and starts empty at the pad you pick.
